name: Checkov Open Source IaC Scanner (Local)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source local/CI scanner for infrastructure-as-code, container images and dependency misconfigurations; no vendor-imposed license seat or scan quota for the CLI.
watch_out: This is the free Checkov CLI, not the paid Prisma Cloud platform. CI runner, cloud accounts, remote integrations and third-party services may cost money; findings require manual review and remediation.
